project.title: Global Pathogen Analysis System
project.goal: Give researchers and public health authorities around the world one standardized cloud platform for analyzing and comparing COVID-19 genomic data, so they can spot emerging variants sooner.
project.value: Researchers lacked the infrastructure to process sequences quickly and share results securely across borders. Built with the University of Oxford, the platform gave them one standardized place to analyze their data, and labs could choose to share results with others.
project.role: I was a Sr. UX Designer on Oracle's design team, working with Oxford University's product manager, research scientists, and public health officials. I improved the design to make the data easier to understand through clearer organization and visualizations.

impact.label: Time for labs to receive processed sequences

next.title: ActiveCampaign App
next.goal: Integrate the value of ActiveCampaign with the lives of our clients by providing key features on the go, allowing them to manage their business wherever they are.
next.value: A streamlined, intuitive interface lets users review important campaign and automation performance whenever they want, and the built-in CRM lets them manage their entire sales team and pipeline from the field. The app keeps business owners connected to customers, not their computer.
next.role: I led design of two iOS and Android apps, working on a cross-functional team with a product manager and five iOS and five Android engineers.
